title: Gerald F. Lackey, PhD — Ries may be 'the first to assemble a practical blueprint for moving beyond' shareholder primacy
summary: Gerald F. Lackey, PhD — governance/strategy researcher — publishes a substantive framing of Incorruptible against the recent Delaware PBC ruling: Ries wasn't the first to challenge shareholder primacy, but he may be the first to assemble a practical blueprint for moving beyond it — one supported by a community of purpose-driven founders and a law firm designed to help them put the model into practice.
blockquote: Eric Ries was not the first to challenge the doctrine of shareholder primacy. But he may be the first to assemble a practical blueprint for moving beyond it, supported by a community of purpose-driven founders and a law firm designed to help them put the model into practice.
blockquote_source: Gerald F. Lackey, PhD on LinkedIn
